## Emerald 2.3.1

### Images beside text

- Inline images now render in Edit Mode while you type beside them. Place an
  album cover before a song title and artist, including in bullet or task lists.
- Insert Image, image paste, and image drop place attachments at the caret and
  leave space to continue writing on the same line.
- Images beside text default to compact thumbnails in Edit and Read Mode.
  Use `![Cover|64](cover.jpg)` or `![[cover.jpg|64]]` to choose a width.
- Move the caret into an image token, or select its line, to edit its Markdown.
  Standalone images keep their existing larger previews.
